notes: Two usable lists: the NYU Stern Management and Organizations doctoral alumni page (2008-2019, first placement plus current position where given; management/organizational behavior area, classify later) and the NC State Operations Research PhD job-market page (names only, no placements, 2022 capture). The six tpp.mit.edu thesis pages (2016-2021) list named thesis authors with titles and advisors, but TPP is MIT's two-year S.M. program and the pages do not label the degree; marked not-a-list as master's theses, so an integrator who wants master's-level thesis lists should reconsider them. Both bschool.nus.edu.sg captures are Incapsula block pages, so the NUS PhD alumni and Strategy and Policy placements pages remain unreviewed and need a live fetch. The Monash WIL pages are undergraduate/master's internship pages, but their navigation includes a 'Previous PhD Candidates and Placements' link under the Monash Business School graduate research section, which is a candidate page not in this batch. Institutions by host were kept for all entries; the MIT Press and ALERT pages concern other universities' graduates but are not lists.
